opinion.headline: Double entry
opinion.hook: The universe follows a cosmic accounting system.
opinion.summary: Every good deed earns credit, while every wrong action incurs a debit. These karmic balances are carried forward, even across lifetimes. Individuals must manage their own karmic ledgers. Acts of revenge create negative karmic entries. The cycle continues until one chooses to cease actions that cause imbalance.

opinion.headline: Education policy failure is being dressed up as innovation, employer abdication as a skills gap
opinion.hook: Indian universities are failing to equip graduates with needed skills.
opinion.summary: Private firms now offer expensive courses, creating a barrier for many. This practice disadvantages first-generation students. Employers once provided on-the-job training. Now, graduates must pay for certifications. This system replicates inequality. Universities and employers must collaborate to ensure affordable skill development and fair hiring practices for all.
